channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: These quotes reveal how Lululemon's founder really feels about the athleisure brand
item.description: Chip Wilson, Lululemon's founder, isn't afraid to speak his mind about his former company, which he still holds an 8% stake in.

item.title: I paid $500 for a private room with 2 beds and a toilet on a 30-hour Amtrak ride. Take a look inside.
item.description: I booked Amtrak's private roomette on an overnight train from NYC to Miami in 2021. It packed a lot into 20 square feet.

item.title: When I was diagnosed with low sperm count, I felt guilty and embarrassed. I want to break the taboo.
item.description: After months of trying for a baby, Brian Mazza learned he had a low sperm count. He turned to IVF and now speaks openly about male infertility.

item.title: Tatiana Schlossberg, granddaughter of JFK, has died of blood cancer at 35
item.description: Tatiana Schlossberg, granddaughter of JFK and a prominent environmental journalist, has died of leukemia at age 35.

item.title: New Pentagon maps show the reach of China's expanding missile force
item.description: China's missile arsenal can strike targets around Taiwan, across the Indo-Pacific, and even in the continental US. The maps paint a clear picture.

item.title: Meet the newest generation of the Kennedy family, America's most famous political dynasty
item.description: The younger members of the Kennedy family, one of the most famous political dynasties in the US, include authors, actors, and journalists.

item.title: Business leaders from Palmer Luckey to David Sacks react to California's proposed billionaire tax
item.description: Bill Ackman, Palmer Luckey, Garry Tan, and more are sharing their opinions on a California billionaire tax proposal.

item.title: Brian Niccol said a Reddit thread of people interviewing for his company showed him that his 'Back to Starbucks' plan was working
item.description: Reddit users advising Starbucks job candidates said interviewees should be ready to discuss customer service.

item.title: A Groq investor said he's 'deeply concerned' about the data center market
item.description: Alex Davis, CEO of Disruptive Tech, said AI has spurred "too many business models with no realistic margin expansion," such as data centers.

item.title: The search for MH370 is back on, nearly 12 years after it vanished
item.description: Malaysia has resumed the search for MH370, the plane that disappeared mysteriously in 2014.
